overview.description: The MicroSectors U.S. Big Banks 3 Leveraged ETN (BNKU) is an exchange-traded product that mostly invests in financials equity. The fund aims to provide three times the daily performance of an equal-weighted index of US large banks. BNKU was launched on Feb 19, 2025 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
